awards.title: Awards
awards.subtitle: Recognizing outstanding contributions
awards.intro: We are pleased to recognize exceptional papers presented at our workshop. Awards are determined by the program committee based on novelty, technical quality, and impact.

selection.overview: The awards committee evaluates all accepted papers based on reviewer feedback, presentation quality, and overall impact.

workshopHistory.title: LIMIT @ ICCV 2025
workshopHistory.description: The inaugural LIMIT Workshop focused on representation learning with very limited resources, featuring 4 invited speakers, 21 accepted papers (4 oral, 17 poster), and lively discussions on learning under data, label, and compute constraints.
